rationale: The available summary consists solely of the opening procedural sentence of Procesverloop (evidenced by the dangling '(hierna: Wilg)' and '(hierna: het inrichtingsplan)' definitions), stating only that the provincial executive adopted 'Planwijziging inrichtingsplan Franekeradeel-Harlingen' pursuant to Article 17(1) of the Wet inrichting landelijk gebied (Wilg). Because an inrichtingsplan amendment under the Wilg is a multi-sector rural development instrument that can substantively regulate either rural water management (waterhuishouding, water retention, waterways, pumping stations) or non-water land consolidation, nature and infrastructure, and the truncated header omits any description of the plan amendment's contents or the grounds of appeal, whether the dispute is substantively water-related cannot be determined from the available text.
